# Loss of symbol-level anchoring when symbols are unknown

Anchors in LLM output are filtered to known_symbols; any symbol paths not observed by the deterministic pass are dropped. If no valid symbol anchors remain, the extractor falls back to a file-level anchor, reducing traceability to specific symbols.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/extractors/llm_extractor.py` — `knowledge_compiler.extractors.llm_extractor.LLMSemanticExtractor._to_facts`
